title: Scale-Up of Soluble PhaZ Hydrolase Production from 2-L to 30-L Fermentation Using Fixed Aeration and Agitation
authors: Noah Pike, Imani Rao, and Celia Moss | Synthetic Fermentation Evaluation Unit
research_question: How does fixed-setting scale-up from 2 L to 30 L affect biomass, soluble PhaZ production, insoluble product, acetate, and enzyme quality?
key_findings: Soluble PhaZ decreased from 8.2 to 6.3 mg/L
conclusion: Scale-up increased biomass but reduced soluble product; oxygen limitation is plausible but unproven.
critical_negations: Dissolved oxygen was not measured at 30 L
Specific activity did not decrease materially
forbidden_claims: A DO cascade was used at 30 L
